close_reason: Propagated canonical-template handle_* wire-shape rustdoc pattern from jmap-mail-server (bd:JMAP-h47t.30.7) to jmap-chat-server. 39 handle_* fns across 9 files + module-level '# Wire-shape contract' paragraphs on all 9. Pure docs. All gates green.
description:
Propagate the workspace-canonical wire-shape rustdoc pattern established in JMAP-h47t.17 (tasks-server, commit 216cc61) and being applied to the canonical jmap-mail-server under JMAP-h47t.30 to jmap-chat-server.

Pattern (extracted from commit 216cc61 in tasks-server, then the canonical jmap-mail-server pass under JMAP-h47t.30):

1. Module-level '# Wire-shape contract' section in each src/*.rs file that defines handle_* fns. Explains the RFC 8620 §5.x → spec section mapping that all handle_* fns in the module conform to, when the extra Vec<Invocation> is non-empty, and which JmapError variants surface as method-level errors.

2. Per-handler 'args is the RFC 8620 §5.x request shape (...); the returned Value is the §5.x response shape (...)' paragraph, naming the required and optional wire fields explicitly so a consumer reading docs.rs does not need RFC 8620 open in another tab.

3. Per-handler 'Returns (response_args, extra_invocations). The extra list is always empty.' trailer (or '... is populated with ...' for handlers that emit follow-up invocations like /copy with onSuccessDestroyOriginal).

Pure docs change. No public API change. Zero test churn. cargo doc -p jmap-chat-server --no-deps -- -D warnings must stay clean.

Parent: JMAP-h47t.30. Cross-reference: JMAP-h47t.17 (tasks-server origin).
